risks.title: Regulatory and market uncertainty impacting vaccine demand and approvals
risks.score_rationale: Directly referenced as ongoing challenge in Item 1A Risk Factors. Changes in FDA regulatory policies, CDC/ACIP recommendations, and post-marketing safety monitoring have materially impacted 2025 operations. Company explicitly states this uncertainty may continue to affect demand, costs, and future approvals. Critical risk for vaccine business model. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Changes in FDA regulatory policies, CDC/ACIP recommendations, post-marketing safety monitoring requirements, and evidentiary expectations directly impact vaccine demand, cost structure, and future.
risks.description: Changes in FDA regulatory policies, CDC/ACIP recommendations, post-marketing safety monitoring requirements, and evidentiary expectations directly impact vaccine demand, cost structure, and future product approvals. Regulatory shifts in 2025 affected COVID vaccine policies and vaccination recommendations. Directly referenced as ongoing challenge in Item 1A Risk Factors.

risks.title: Declining COVID vaccine demand and market saturation
risks.score_rationale: Revenue declined 40.6% primarily due to lower COVID vaccine demand. 99.6% of 2025 product sales ($1.81B of $1.82B) derived from COVID vaccines. Risk factor explicitly states 'If demand for COVID vaccines continues to decline, we lose significant market share, or our products are subject to significant competitive pricing pressure, our product sales may not materialize consistent with our projections.' (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: COVID vaccine market normalization and declining vaccination rates create significant revenue headwinds.
risks.description: COVID vaccine market normalization and declining vaccination rates create significant revenue headwinds. Forecast accuracy challenges due to factors including viral evolution, medical need perception, and consumer vaccination motivation. Competitive pricing pressure limiting margins. Revenue declined 40.6% primarily due to lower COVID vaccine demand.

risks.title: Intense competition in vaccines and oncology markets
risks.score_rationale: Competition from established large pharmaceutical companies limits market share, contract negotiation leverage, and profitability. Specific competitive challenges noted in COVID vaccine market. Oncology pipeline competes with established therapies and multiple development-stage programs from competitors. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Established pharmaceutical competitors with greater resources, distribution networks, and market presence pose ongoing competitive threats.
risks.description: Established pharmaceutical competitors with greater resources, distribution networks, and market presence pose ongoing competitive threats. Market share losses in COVID vaccines and competition in emerging oncology and infectious disease segments constrain commercial opportunity and pricing power.

risks.title: Commercialization execution and cost management challenges
risks.score_rationale: Company pursuing 'more selective approach' and cost management to achieve profitability. Loss per share of $(7.26) indicates ongoing operational challenges. Risk of failing to successfully commercialize development pipeline and manage operating costs effectively, which would impact R&D investment capacity and strategic objectives. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Managing commercial execution of development pipeline, controlling operating expenses, and investing in R&D while pursuing profitability represent significant near-term challenges.
risks.description: Managing commercial execution of development pipeline, controlling operating expenses, and investing in R&D while pursuing profitability represent significant near-term challenges. Failure to balance these priorities could undermine long-term value creation and competitive positioning. Company pursuing 'more selective approach' and cost management to achieve profitability.

risks.title: Reimbursement uncertainty and pricing pressure from payers
risks.score_rationale: Third-party payer reimbursement decisions critical to pharmaceutical revenue realization. Policy changes, pricing pressure, and consolidation among payers create material revenue uncertainty. Government pricing initiatives including 'most-favored-nation' models add unpredictability. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Reimbursement policies and pricing decisions by public and private payers directly determine product revenue potential. Policy changes, price negotiations, and payer consolidation create uncertainty.
risks.description: Reimbursement policies and pricing decisions by public and private payers directly determine product revenue potential. Policy changes, price negotiations, and payer consolidation create uncertainty. Government pricing regulations create structural uncertainty for revenue projections. Third-party payer reimbursement decisions critical to pharmaceutical revenue realization.

risks.title: Government pricing regulations and policy uncertainty
risks.score_rationale: Executive orders on drug price reduction and most-favored-nation pricing models create significant uncertainty regarding implementation and impact. Ongoing policy developments affect U.S. and international revenue potential for both current products and pipeline candidates. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Government initiatives to regulate pharmaceutical pricing, including most-favored-nation pricing models, create material uncertainty for U.S. and international revenue projections.
risks.description: Government initiatives to regulate pharmaceutical pricing, including most-favored-nation pricing models, create material uncertainty for U.S. and international revenue projections. Policy implementation timelines and scope remain unclear. Executive orders on drug price reduction and most-favored-nation pricing models create significant uncertainty regarding implementation and impact.

risks.title: Small addressable markets and patient identification challenges in rare disease
risks.score_rationale: Rare disease programs (propionic acidemia, methylmalonic acidemia) face inherently smaller patient populations that are difficult to identify and recruit. Market size estimates may prove inaccurate. Clinical trial enrollment and long-term commercialization face structural limitations. (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Rare disease therapeutic candidates address small patient populations that are difficult to identify and locate for clinical trials and commercialization.
risks.description: Rare disease therapeutic candidates address small patient populations that are difficult to identify and locate for clinical trials and commercialization. Market size estimates may be overstated, limiting commercial revenue potential. Rare disease programs (propionic acidemia, methylmalonic acidemia) face inherently smaller patient populations that are difficult to identify and recruit.
